# Import and analyze Metagenome-Assembled Genomes (MAGs)

## Set up

```{r}
#| label: load packages

library(Biostrings)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(vcfR) # installed memuse dependency
library(Rsamtools)
```

## Import data

``` {r}
#| label: upzip files

# Unzip the MAG sequences into the mags folder
unzip("molecular/genomics/mags/bin.010.fasta_assembly.zip", exdir = "molecular/genomics/mags/")

# Unzip the metadata into the metadata folder (if it downloaded as a zip)
unzip("molecular/genomics/metadata/bin.010.fasta_assembly.json.zip", exdir = "molecular/genomics/metadata/")

```

```{r}

bin010_vcf <- read.vcfR("molecular/genomics/mags/bin010_variants.flt.vcf")

# confirm allele depth exists
queryMETA(bin010_vcf, element = "FORMAT")

#extract allele depth
bin010_ad <- extract.gt(bin010_vcf, element = "AD")
bin010_ad_split <- strsplit(bin010_ad[,1], ",")

bin010_ref_counts <- as.numeric(sapply(bin010_ad_split, '[',1))
bin010_alt_counts <- as.numeric(sapply(bin010_ad_split, '[',2))
bin010_total_counts <- bin010_ref_counts + bin010_alt_counts

bin010_alt_freq <- bin010_alt_counts/bin010_total_counts

# drop low coverage sites
bin010_alt_freq_filt <-bin010_alt_freq[bin010_total_counts >= 10]

```

```{r}
hist(bin010_alt_freq_filt, breaks = 50,
    main = "Alt allele frequency across SNP sites for bin010",
    xlab = "Alt allele frequency")

```

```{r}

bin010_bamfile <- "molecular/genomics/mags/bin010_sorted_mapped_reads.bam"
if(!file.exists(paste0(bin010_bamfile, ".bai"))) indexBam(bin010_bamfile)

param <- PileupParam(distinguish_strands = FALSE, distinguish_nucleotides = FALSE)
pile <-pileup(bin010_bamfile, pileupParam = param)

bin010_coverage_per_contig <- aggregate(count ~ seqnames, data = pile, FUN = mean)
colnames(bin010_coverage_per_contig) <- c("contig", "mean_coverage")

```

```{r}

bin010_seqs <- readDNAStringSet("molecular/genomics/mags/bin.010.fasta_assembly.fa")
bin010_gc_per_contig <- data.frame(
    contig = names(bin010_seqs),
    gc = letterFrequency(bin010_seqs, letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)[,1]*100,
    length = width(bin010_seqs)
)

bin010_merge <- merge(bin010_coverage_per_contig, bin010_gc_per_contig, by = "contig")
```

```{r}

plot(
    bin010_merge$gc, bin010_merge$mean_coverage,
    cex = sqrt(bin010_merge$length)/100,
    xlab = "GC%", ylab = "Mean coverage",
    main = "bin010: Coverage vs. GC per contig"
)

```

```{bash}
#| label: install instrain
conda create -n instrain python=3.9 -y
conda run -n instrain pip install instrain

```

```{bash}
conda run n instrain profile sorted
```
